# Hyprdrive configuration keys

**Generated by `scripts/gen_keys_table.sh` from `Config.cpp`. Do not edit.**
Regenerate after adding or changing a key; `--check` fails if this file is stale.

Every key lives under `plugin:hyprdrive:`. 80 keys.

**Compatibility.** The plugin was called `scrolloverview`; every key is
also registered under the old `plugin:scrolloverview:` prefix and a value set
there is copied onto the new name at config reload (the new name wins if
both are set). The old spelling prints one deprecation warning per session
and is removed one release after the rename.

## General

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gesture_distance` | int | `200` | >= 1 | gesture distance in pixels |
| `col_highlight` | color/gradient | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` |  | colour of the selection/hover highlights; unset falls back to general:col.active_border |
| `scale` | float | `0.82` | 0.1 .. 0.9 | overview scale |
| `anim_scale` | float | `1` | 0 .. 100 | global animation slowdown; 1 = normal, 10 = ten times slower, 0 = snap |
| `open_speed` | float | `2.6` | 0.1 .. 20 | overview open duration, tenths of a second |
| `close_speed` | float | `1.9` | 0.1 .. 20 | overview close duration, tenths of a second |
| `workspace_gap` | int | `40` | >= 0 | gap between overview workspaces |
| `layout` | string | `"vertical"` |  | overview layout |
| `terminal` | string | `""` |  | terminal used to launch Terminal=true desktop entries; empty falls back to $TERMINAL |
| `drag_mini_scale` | float | `0.45` | 0.05 .. 1 | size of the drag proxy while it hovers another workspace, as a fraction of its tile size |
| `drag_mini_ms` | int | `150` | >= 0 | ms for the drag proxy to shrink to, or grow back from, mini scale |
| `drag_recentre_ms` | int | `160` | >= 0 | ms for the drag proxy's grab point to slide to its centre while over a drop target |
| `wallpaper` | int | `0` | 0 .. 2 | wallpaper mode |
| `blur` | bool | `false` |  | blur the overview wallpaper |
| `live_layer_frost` | bool | `true` |  | evaluate dock/bar frost against the overview backdrop instead of the stale optimized blur FB |
| `prefilter_below` | float | `0.55` | 0 .. 1 | mipmap-prefilter a tile's texture when it is minified below this fraction (0 = never) |
| `mission_control` | bool | `true` |  | lay the focused workspace out as a mission-control grid |
| `mission_control_gap` | int | `40` | >= 0 | gap between mission-control grid tiles |
| `mission_control_reflow_ms` | int | `300` | >= 0 | ms for a grid tile to travel to a new slot |
| `strip` | bool | `true` |  | workspace thumbnail strip across the top of the overview |
| `strip_height` | int | `260` | >= 0 | logical px the strip band reserves at the top of the workspace |
| `strip_gap` | int | `5` | >= 0 | gap between strip cells |
| `tap_super` | bool | `true` |  | tapping SUPER alone toggles the overview |
| `tap_super_timeout_ms` | int | `250` | >= 0 | longest press-to-release still counted as a SUPER tap (0 = no limit) |

## `input`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:input:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scroll_event_delay` | int | `200` | >= 0 | minimum delay (ms) between discrete scroll steps (wheel workspace nav and trackpad focus stepping) |
| `touchpad_scroll_factor` | float | `1` | >= 0 | overview touchpad scroll factor |
| `left_handed` | int | `2` | 0 .. 2 | overview left handed mouse buttons, 2 follows input:left_handed |
| `scrolling_mode` | int | `0` | 0 .. 3 | overview mouse wheel behavior |
| `drag_mode` | int | `0` | 0 .. 1 | overview mouse drag behavior |
| `drag_threshold` | int | `10` | >= 0 | overview drag threshold |

## `dock`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:dock:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: draw the dock |
| `icon_size` | int | `54` | 8 .. 512 | hyprgnomedock: max icon size (dash-max-icon-size) |
| `height_fraction` | float | `0.90` | 0.05 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: max fraction of the monitor's long axis the dock may span |
| `corner_radius` | int | `24` | >= 0 | hyprgnomedock: pill corner radius |
| `minimize_ms` | int | `400` | 0 .. 2000 | hyprgnomedock: minimize/restore flight duration, 0 to teleport (Y5: GNOME's MINIMIZE_WINDOW_ANIMATION_TIME) |
| `autohide` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: hide the dock until the bottom edge is pressed (D2D autohide) |
| `pressure_threshold` | float | `100` | 0 .. 2000 | hyprgnomedock: px of motion pushed into the bottom edge before the dock reveals (D2D pressure-threshold) |
| `require_pressure` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: the bottom edge must be PUSHED past pressure_threshold, not merely touched (D2D require-pressure-to-show) |
| `show_delay_ms` | int | `250` | 0 .. 5000 | hyprgnomedock: delay from the barrier trigger to the reveal (D2D show-delay) |
| `hide_delay_ms` | int | `200` | 0 .. 5000 | hyprgnomedock: delay from the pointer leaving to the hide (D2D hide-delay) |
| `autohide_ms` | int | `200` | 0 .. 2000 | hyprgnomedock: slide duration (D2D animation-time) |
| `running_indicator` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: dot under a running app's icon (D2D show-running) |
| `indicator_color` | color | `0` |  | hyprgnomedock: running-dot colour (alpha 0 = follow general:col.active_border) |
| `indicator_size` | int | `5` | 1 .. 64 | hyprgnomedock: running-dot diameter in px |
| `notification_counter` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: red count badge on the icon (D2D show-icons-notifications-counter) |
| `emblems` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: draw Unity LauncherEntry emblems at all (D2D show-icons-emblems) |
| `dance_urgent` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: wiggle an urgent app's icon (D2D dance-urgent-applications) |
| `urgent_notify` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: reveal the dock when an app goes urgent (D2D show-dock-urgent-notify) |
| `flight_log` | bool | `false` |  | flight lifecycle log to /tmp/ovdbg.log, for scripts/z_rig.sh + zflight_gate.py |
| `show_favorites` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: pinned apps in the dock whether running or not (D2D show-favorites) |
| `show_apps_button` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: the Show Applications button (D2D show-show-apps-button) |
| `show_apps_at_top` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: Show Applications at the START of the dock (D2D show-apps-at-top) |
| `show_apps_always_in_the_edge` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: keep Show Applications hard against the dock's edge (D2D show-apps-always-in-the-edge) |
| `show_apps_icon` | string | `"view-app-grid-symbolic"` |  | hyprgnomedock: Show Applications artwork |
| `scroll_action` | string | `"cycle-windows"` |  | hyprgnomedock: wheel over the dock: cycle-windows | switch-workspace | do-nothing (D2D scroll-action) |
| `middle_click_action` | string | `"launch"` |  | hyprgnomedock: middle click on an icon: launch | minimize | cycle-windows | quit | skip (D2D middle-click-action) |
| `shift_middle_click_action` | string | `"launch"` |  | hyprgnomedock: shift+middle click on an icon (D2D shift-middle-click-action) |
| `isolate_workspaces` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: the dock lists only windows on the current workspace (D2D isolate-workspaces) |
| `workspace_agnostic_urgent` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: an urgent window stays listed even when isolate_workspaces hides its workspace (D2D workspace-agnostic-urgent-windows) |
| `hot_keys` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: Super+number activates dock apps (D2D hot-keys) |
| `hotkeys_overlay` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a hotkey press draws the slot numbers on the icons (D2D hotkeys-overlay) |
| `hotkeys_show_dock` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a hotkey press reveals a hidden dock while the overlay is up (D2D hotkeys-show-dock) |
| `shortcut_timeout` | float | `2` | 0 .. 10 | hyprgnomedock: seconds the number overlay stays up (D2D shortcut-timeout) |
| `show_trash` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a Trash item at the end of the dock (D2D show-trash) |
| `show_mounts` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: mounted volumes as dock items (D2D show-mounts) |
| `show_mounts_network` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: include network shares among the mounts (D2D show-mounts-network) |
| `show_mounts_only_mounted` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: only volumes that are mounted, not every one present (D2D show-mounts-only-mounted) |
| `isolate_locations` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a location's running state is its own, not the file manager's (D2D isolate-locations) |
| `background_color` | color | `0` |  | hyprgnomedock: pill hue (alpha 0 = Omarchy terminal background, else misc:background_color; opacity is background_opacity) |
| `background_opacity` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: pill alpha (-1 = Omarchy default-opacity) |
| `blur_size` | int | `-1` | -1 .. 64 | hyprgnomedock: blur size (-1 = follow decoration:blur:size) |
| `blur_passes` | int | `-1` | -1 .. 10 | hyprgnomedock: blur passes (-1 = follow decoration:blur:passes) |
| `blur_brightness` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 2 | hyprgnomedock: blur brightness (blur-my-shell brightness; -1 = follow decoration:blur:brightness) |
| `blur_noise` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: blur grain; the reference has none (-1 = follow decoration:blur:noise) |
| `blur_contrast` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 2 | hyprgnomedock: blur contrast; the reference applies none (-1 = follow decoration:blur:contrast) |
| `blur_vibrancy` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: blur vibrancy; the reference applies none (-1 = follow decoration:blur:vibrancy) |

## `shadow`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:shadow:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | `false` |  | draw a shadow around each workspace card |
| `range` | int | `-1` |  | workspace card shadow range |
| `render_power` | int | `-1` |  | workspace card shadow render power |
| `color` | color/gradient | `-1` |  | workspace card shadow color |
